decisive_spans.text: Spherical broadly based budding yeast on Grocott-Gomori methenamine silver stain

response.rationale: The presence of a positive Blastomyces urine antigen and the finding of spherical broadly based budding yeast on Grocott-Gomori methenamine silver stain are highly specific for Blastomycosis. While Histoplasmosis also has a positive blood antigen, the microscopic findings strongly favor Blastomycosis.
